why.T3-121: The item centers on sanctioning a person who damages Blue or its neighbours: asking mods to ban 'him' and publicly blaming the person ruining Blue are exclusion/shunning acts, not merely messaging a placer to stop.

why.T3-065: The Senyera is the room's regional/national flag, and the concepts propose it, call Catalans to build it, and direct its immediate pixels, so it is the homeland flag as the mark rather than a generic call for hands or a mere mark proposal.

why.T3-038: The item records the mark being made and reported: the design is drawn at a linked location and completion is announced, so it is building/reporting the mark rather than merely proposing it (T3-033) or calling for hands (T3-002).

why.T3-065: The item is centered on the Swedish flag as the room's national mark: proposing where Sweden would lie, starting and filling the flag, correcting its proportions, repairing it, and arguing how large or clean it should stay.

why.T3-014: The item's organizing practice is moving builders and decisions into the drumcorps Discord and directing people there, so it is the room's own planning chat rather than a report of chat decisions (T3-152) or a general call to place.

why.T3-017: The Quidditch bot release, double-ball interpretation and catching time are the sub's ordinary house game continuing during the canvas window, apart from canvas work or April Fools.
why.T3-159: The house points awarded for r/place organizing, rallying, negotiation and Buffalo Bills are a prize/reward for helpers, distinct from the ordinary Quidditch play.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-017 alone would carry the ordinary Quidditch play but not the house points explicitly awarded for r/place organizing and ally recognition.

why.T3-076: The item is an argument inside the room over Badgers attacking a fellow B1G mark: one reports the sabotage, another tells them not to sabotage and to maintain their own logo instead, which is reining in the room's attackers.

why.T3-015: Moderators remove separate r/place posts and redirect updates and alarms to a megathread/sticky, gathering canvas talk in one place.
why.T3-063: The scenery and Place 2.0 proposals are removed under the standing Dark Souls 1-only rule, with no pointer to the canvas megathread, so they are rule-based removals.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-015 alone would not carry the removals of the scenery and Place 2.0 posts under the sub's Dark Souls 1-only rule, because those are not redirections to the megathread.

why.T3-006: The dominant calls are blunt removal/destruction of other work: kill the Destiny 2 logo, remove Indian-flag clutter, replace OSU/TTN, and poll what to do to the blue cultists.
why.T3-061: Some calls are displacement into another community's space, telling a small community it can move and claiming the canvas as r/metalcore's mourning place.
why.T3-068: One call asks placestart to brand Remain across the Union Jack, converting another room's art into a political slogan/sign.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-006 alone would not carry the displacement/space-taking calls or the conversion of the Union Jack into a Remain slogan.

why.T3-073: The item is mostly a first account after placement ends: what was fixed before shutdown, where the logo formed and changed, Batman repaired, and how place2/Void played out.
why.T3-009: Several turns explicitly celebrate the final logo and team outcome, such as 'ended up nicely and unvandalsavageized. Go team!' and praise of how it looks.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-073 alone would carry the account of what survived but not the explicit celebration of the final logo as a finished achievement.

why.T3-031: The room's public valuation of its carrot-themed replies shows the community playing its own in-joke answer to the wrecking.
why.T3-050: The provoking act is a taunt at the farmers for being destroyed, which is mockery traded with a rival over the canvas.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-031 alone would not carry the hostile taunt that the item records as the provocation for the carrot-joke replies.

why.T3-021: The item's dominant practice is keeping the road and protected art intact: repairing defects, portals, core, colours, borders, and directing maintenance to the most damaged place.
